request.subject: CITY:UNDEAD:3

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: cheerful spooky storybook, playful and never scary. Everything is made of smooth bleached ivory bone, ragged cloth with torn zigzag hems, dull dark iron and weathered grey stone, with small grey-green moss patches, stitched seams and small cold pale blue flames as details; bone is shaded with cool grey, iron and stone with darker slate blue-grey, never brown.
layers.negative: blood, gore, guts, exposed organs, open wounds, dripping, horror, creepy realism, rotting flesh, slime, glowing green, cyan glow, purple magic glow, orange flames, pumpkin, see-through, translucent, wood, timber, gun, musket, modern clothing, brown boots, brown leather, brown cloth, bronze, copper, verdigris, rust, dark brown shading, red-brown, maroon

layers.text: Class: one settlement map piece, a compact cluster of chunky buildings that fills most of the image, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes. The walls and houses stand directly on the empty transparent background with no ground, soil, grass or platform under them; the bottom of the buildings is the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, people, crowd

layers.text: Team colour: large solid bright red (#d8262c) areas are the maskable owner colour and must be clearly visible from a distance, about a quarter to a third of the subject. No other red or red-brown anywhere: every other material, and its shading, uses colours that are clearly not red or red-brown.

Subject: a large level-3 necropolis, the biggest settlement: many chunky grey stone crypts and mausoleums with bright red slate roofs packed inside a crenellated weathered grey stone ring wall with a pointed arch gate, two crooked round corner towers with bright red cone roofs and a tall central gothic crypt spire with a big ragged bright red banner flag, long bright red drapes hanging on the wall beside the gate, ivory bone trim, bare leafless dead trees with dark slate-grey branches and cold pale blue flames in iron braziers on the towers; wide and chunky, filling the whole image. Buildings only.
Big bright red roofs cover most of the necropolis and are its largest areas, shaded only with darker red.
layers.negative: skeleton, zombie, ghost, soldier, guard, warrior, person, villager, character, creature, face, orange roof
